35: - Never bypass legal, physical-presence, CAPTCHA, identity-proofing, or electronic-signature boundaries.", "instruction.md": "1: # GeekNews Search
2: 
3: ## What this skill does
4: 
5: GeekNews 공개 RSS/Atom 피드(`https://feeds.feedburner.com/geeknews-feed`)를 사용해 최신 글을 읽기 전용으로 조회한다.
6: 
7: - 최신 글 목록 조회
8: - 제목/요약/작성자 기준 검색
9: - 항목 id/link 기준 상세 확인
10: 
11: ## When to use
12: 
13: - "긱뉴스 오늘 뭐 올라왔어?"
14: - "긱뉴스에서 Claude 관련 글 찾아줘"
15: - "이 GeekNews 글 요약/링크 확인해줘"
16: 
17: ## Inputs
18: 
19: - 기본: 별도 인증 없이 public feed만 사용
20: - 목록 조회: `limit`
21: - 검색: `query`, 선택 `limit`
22: - 상세 조회: `id` 또는 링크/토픽 번호 일부
23: 
24: ## Official surface
25: 
26: - GeekNews RSS/Atom feed: `https://feeds.feedburner.com/geeknews-feed`
27: - GeekNews home: `https://news.hada.io`
28: 
29: ## Workflow
30: 
31: ### 1) List recent entries
32: 
33: ```bash
34: npx -y @nomadamas/k-skill@0 exec geeknews-search scripts/geeknews_search.py -- list --limit 10
35: ```
36: 
37: ### 2) Search the feed conservatively
38: 
39: ```bash
40: npx -y @nomadamas/k-skill@0 exec geeknews-search scripts/geeknews_search.py -- search --query Claude --limit 5
41: ```
42: 
43: 검색은 제목, 요약, 작성자, 링크/id 기준으로만 동작한다.
44: 
45: ### 3) Inspect a specific item
46: 
47: ```bash
48: npx -y @nomadamas/k-skill@0 exec geeknews-search scripts/geeknews_search.py -- detail --id 28439
49: ```
50: 
51: 상세 조회는 RSS 피드에 포함된 `content`/요약과 원문 링크를 함께 돌려준다.
52: 
53: ## Done when
54: 
55: - 최신 GeekNews 글 목록을 바로 보여줄 수 있다.
56: - 키워드 검색 결과에서 제목/링크/작성자/요약을 정리할 수 있다.
57: - 특정 항목의 RSS 기반 내용을 보수적으로 확인하고 원문 링크를 함께 제시할 수 있다.
58: 
59: ## Failure modes
60: 
61: - FeedBurner/GeekNews feed가 일시적으로 응답하지 않을 수 있다.
62: - RSS 피드가 제공하는 범위를 넘는 전체 본문/댓글/투표 정보는 포함되지 않는다.
63: - HTML 요약은 feed 원문 기준이라 일부가 잘릴 수 있다.
64: 
65: ## Notes
66: 
67: - v1은 RSS-first, read-only 범위다.
68: - 비공식 API나 로그인 세션에 의존하지 않는다.
69: - 테스트/오프라인 검증 시 `--feed-file` 로 저장된 Atom XML을 넣을 수 있다.", "scripts/geeknews_search.py": "1: #!/usr/bin/env python3
2: 
3: from __future__ import annotations
4: 
5: import argparse
6: import json
7: import re
8: import urllib.request
9: from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass
10: from html import unescape
11: from html.parser import HTMLParser
12: from pathlib import Path
13: 
14: GEEKNEWS_FEED_URL = "https://feeds.feedburner.com/geeknews-feed"
15: 
16: 
17: class _TextExtractor(HTMLParser):
18:     def __init__(self) -> None:
19:         super().__init__()
20:         self.parts: list[str] = []
21: 
22:     def handle_data(self, data: str) -> None:
23:         self.parts.append(data)
24: 
25:     def text(self) -> str:
26:         return " ".join(part.strip() for part in self.parts if part.strip())
27: 
28: 
29: @dataclass(frozen=True)
30: class GeekNewsItem:
31:     id: str
32:     title: str
33:     link: str
34:     published: str | None
35:     updated: str | None
36:     author_name: str | None
37:     author_url: str | None
38:     summary: str
39:     content_html: str
40: 
41:     def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, object]:
42:         return asdict(self)
43: 
44: 
45: @dataclass(frozen=True)
46: class GeekNewsFeed:
47:     title: str
48:     source_id: str | None
49:     updated: str | None
50:     home_url: str | None
51:     feed_url: str | None
52:     category: str | None
53:     items: list[GeekNewsItem]
54: 
55:     def source_dict(self) -> dict[str, object]:
56:         return {
57:             "title": self.title,
58:             "id": self.source_id,
59:             "updated": self.updated,
60:             "home_url": self.home_url,
61:             "feed_url": self.feed_url,
62:             "category": self.category,
63:         }
64: 
65: 
66: def _strip_cdata(value: str | None) -> str:
67:     if not value:
68:         return ""
69:     stripped = value.strip()
70:     if stripped.startswith("<![CDATA[") and stripped.endswith("]]>"):
71:         return stripped[9:-3]
72:     return stripped
73: 
74: 
75: def _collapse_whitespace(value: str) -> str:
76:     return re.sub(r"\s+", " ", value).strip()
77: 
78: 
79: def _clean_xml_text(value: str | None) -> str:
80:     return _collapse_whitespace(unescape(_strip_cdata(value)))
81: 
82: 
83: def _html_to_text(html: str) -> str:
84:     parser = _TextExtractor()
85:     parser.feed(html)
86:     parser.close()
87:     return _collapse_whitespace(unescape(parser.text()))
88: 
89: 
90: def _first_tag(block: str, tag: str) -> str | None:
91:     match = re.search(rf"<{tag}\b[^>]*>(.*?)</{tag}>", block, re.DOTALL)
92:     if not match:
93:         return None
94:     return _clean_xml_text(match.group(1))
95: 
96: 
97: def _first_raw_tag(block: str, tag: str) -> str | None:
98:     match = re.search(rf"<{tag}\b[^>]*>(.*?)</{tag}>", block, re.DOTALL)
99:     if not match:
100:         return None
101:     return _strip_cdata(match.group(1)).strip()
102: 
103: 
104: def _first_link_href(block: str) -> str | None:
105:     patterns = (
106:         r"<link\b[^>]*rel=['\"]alternate['\"][^>]*href=['\"]([^'\"]+)['\"]",
107:         r"<link\b[^>]*href=['\"]([^'\"]+)['\"]",
108:     )
109:     for pattern in patterns:
110:         match = re.search(pattern, block)
111:         if match:
112:             return unescape(match.group(1).strip())
113:     return None
114: 
115: 
116: def _link_href(block: str, *, rel: str | None = None) -> str | None:
117:     if rel:
118:         match = re.search(
119:             rf"<link\b[^>]*(?:rel|ref)=['\"]{re.escape(rel)}['\"][^>]*href=['\"]([^'\"]+)['\"]",
120:             block,
121:         )
122:         if match:
123:             return unescape(match.group(1).strip())
124:     return _first_link_href(block)
125: 
126: 
127: def _feed_prefix(xml_text: str) -> str:
128:     if "<entry" not in xml_text:
129:         return xml_text
130:     return xml_text.split("<entry", 1)[0]
131: 
132: 
133: def _entry_blocks(xml_text: str) -> list[str]:
134:     return re.findall(r"<entry\b[^>]*>(.*?)</entry>", xml_text, re.DOTALL)
135: 
136: 
137: def _validate_limit(limit: int) -> int:
138:     if limit <= 0:
139:         raise ValueError("limit must be positive")
140:     return limit
141: 
142: 
143: def load_feed(xml_text: str) -> GeekNewsFeed:
144:     prefix = _feed_prefix(xml_text)
145:     items = []
146:     for entry in _entry_blocks(xml_text):
147:         author_block_match = re.search(r"<author\b[^>]*>(.*?)</author>", entry, re.DOTALL)
148:         author_block = author_block_match.group(1) if author_block_match else ""
149:         content_html = (_first_raw_tag(entry, "content") or "").strip()
150:         items.append(
151:             GeekNewsItem(
152:                 id=_first_tag(entry, "id") or "",
153:                 title=_first_tag(entry, "title") or "",
154:                 link=_first_link_href(entry) or (_first_tag(entry, "id") or ""),
155:                 published=_first_tag(entry, "published") or _first_tag(entry, "updated"),
156:                 updated=_first_tag(entry, "updated"),
157:                 author_name=_first_tag(author_block, "name"),
158:                 author_url=_first_tag(author_block, "uri"),
159:                 summary=_html_to_text(content_html),
160:                 content_html=content_html,
161:             )
162:         )
163: 
164:     category_match = re.search(r"<category\b[^>]*term=['\"]([^'\"]+)['\"]", prefix)
165:     return GeekNewsFeed(
166:         title=_first_tag(prefix, "title") or "GeekNews",
167:         source_id=_first_tag(prefix, "id"),
168:         updated=_first_tag(prefix, "updated"),
169:         home_url=_link_href(prefix, rel="alternate"),
170:         feed_url=_link_href(prefix, rel="self") or _first_tag(prefix, "id"),
171:         category=category_match.group(1) if category_match else None,
172:         items=items,
173:     )
174: 
175: 
176: def list_items(feed: GeekNewsFeed, limit: int = 10) -> list[GeekNewsItem]:
177:     return feed.items[:_validate_limit(limit)]
178: 
179: 
180: def search_items(feed: GeekNewsFeed, query: str, limit: int = 10) -> list[GeekNewsItem]:
181:     if not query.strip():
182:         raise ValueError("query is required")
183:     limit = _validate_limit(limit)
184:     needle = query.casefold()
185:     matches = []
186:     for item in feed.items:
187:         haystack = "\n".join(
188:             part
189:             for part in (
190:                 item.title,
191:                 item.summary,
192:                 item.author_name or "",
193:                 item.author_url or "",
194:                 item.id,
195:                 item.link,
196:             )
197:             if part
198:         ).casefold()
199:         if needle in haystack:
200:             matches.append(item)
201:         if len(matches) >= limit:
202:             break
203:     return matches
204: 
205: 
206: def get_item_detail(feed: GeekNewsFeed, lookup: str) -> GeekNewsItem:
207:     normalized_lookup = lookup.strip().casefold()
208:     if not normalized_lookup:
209:         raise ValueError("lookup is required")
210:     for item in feed.items:
211:         candidates = [item.id, item.link, item.title]
212:         lowered = [candidate.casefold() for candidate in candidates if candidate]
213:         if normalized_lookup in lowered or any(normalized_lookup in candidate for candidate in lowered):
214:             return item
215:     raise LookupError(f"No GeekNews entry matched: {lookup}")
216: 
217: 
218: def _serialize_items(items: list[GeekNewsItem]) -> list[dict[str, object]]:
219:     return [item.to_dict() for item in items]
220: 
221: 
222: def build_list_payload(feed: GeekNewsFeed, limit: int = 10) -> dict[str, object]:
223:     items = list_items(feed, limit=limit)
224:     return {"source": feed.source_dict(), "count": len(items), "items": _serialize_items(items)}
225: 
226: 
227: def build_search_payload(feed: GeekNewsFeed, query: str, limit: int = 10) -> dict[str, object]:
228:     items = search_items(feed, query=query, limit=limit)
229:     return {
230:         "source": feed.source_dict(),
231:         "query": query,
232:         "count": len(items),
233:         "items": _serialize_items(items),
234:     }
235: 
236: 
237: def build_detail_payload(feed: GeekNewsFeed, lookup: str) -> dict[str, object]:
238:     item = get_item_detail(feed, lookup)
239:     return {"source": feed.source_dict(), "item": item.to_dict()}
240: 
241: 
242: def fetch_feed(url: str = GEEKNEWS_FEED_URL, timeout: int = 20) -> str:
243:     request = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={"User-Agent": "k-skill-geeknews/1.0"})
244:     with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=timeout) as response:
245:         charset = response.headers.get_content_charset() or "utf-8"
246:         return response.read().decode(charset, errors="replace")
247: 
248: 
249: def _add_feed_source_args(parser: argparse.ArgumentParser) -> None:
250:     parser.add_argument("--feed-url", default=GEEKNEWS_FEED_URL, help="기본값: GeekNews public feed URL")
251:     parser.add_argument("--feed-file", help="테스트/오프라인 검증용 로컬 Atom XML 파일")
252: 
253: 
254: def parse_args(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> argparse.Namespace:
255:     parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Read GeekNews entries from the public RSS/Atom feed.")
256: 
257:     subparsers = parser.add_subparsers(dest="command", required=True)
258: 
259:     list_parser = subparsers.add_parser("list", help="최신 GeekNews 항목 목록")
260:     _add_feed_source_args(list_parser)
261:     list_parser.add_argument("--limit", type=int, default=10)
262: 
263:     search_parser = subparsers.add_parser("search", help="제목/요약/작성자 기준 검색")
264:     _add_feed_source_args(search_parser)
265:     search_parser.add_argument("--query", required=True)
266:     search_parser.add_argument("--limit", type=int, default=10)
267: 
268:     detail_parser = subparsers.add_parser("detail", help="항목 상세 확인")
269:     _add_feed_source_args(detail_parser)
270:     detail_parser.add_argument("--id", required=True, help="entry id/link/topic id 일부")
271: 
272:     return parser.parse_args(argv)
273: 
274: 
275: def _load_feed_text(args: argparse.Namespace) -> str:
276:     if args.feed_file:
277:         return Path(args.feed_file).read_text(encoding="utf-8")
278:     return fetch_feed(url=args.feed_url)
279: 
280: 
281: def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> None:
282:     args = parse_args(argv)
283:     feed = load_feed(_load_feed_text(args))
284: 
285:     if args.command == "list":
286:         payload = build_list_payload(feed, limit=args.limit)
287:     elif args.command == "search":
288:         payload = build_search_payload(feed, query=args.query, limit=args.limit)
289:     else:
290:         payload = build_detail_payload(feed, lookup=args.id)
291: 
292:     print(json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
293: 
294: 
295: if __name__ == "__main__":
296:     main()"}}
